sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the applicant submits that in terms of the said settlement, the company has also agreed to cooperate in quashing of FIR No. 412/2022.
5.

However, the learned counsel who appears for Mr. Anil Kumar Maurya, on the complaint of whom FIR No. 412/2022 was registered, submits that no settlement has been arrived between the complainant Mr. Anil Kumar Maurya and the applicant.
6. He submits that the Settlement Deed dated 09.01.2024 has been executed by Mr. Amit Goel, who is one of the Directors of the company.
He further submits that Mr. Amit Goel was not authorised to enter into any settlement on behalf of the company.
7. It is significant to note that the sum of 25,00,000/-, which has been agreed to be paid by the applicant, is to the benefit of the company and not the individual Directors.
8. It is not the case of the prosecution that Mr. Amit Goel or Mr. Anil Kumar Maurya have been cheated in their personal capacity.
9. In order to show his bona fides, the applicant undertakes to pay a sum of 5,00,000/-, within a period of two weeks from today, to the company.

10. Considering the above, the State is directed not to arrest the applicant till the next date of hearing, subject to the applicant depositing a sum of 5,00,000/- in the account of company and cooperating with the investigation.
This is a digitally signed order.
